episode_summary: In this episode, DJ Paris emphasizes the importance of maintaining relationships with past clients to drive repeat and referral business. He outlines a systematic approach to managing client databases and provides actionable tactics for effective communication. By focusing on personalized, value-driven interactions, agents can significantly enhance their business without relying on cold calls or purchased leads.
